ipos.about: Incorporated in August 2024, Antala Industries Limited is engaged in the manufacturing, processing, printing, laminating and supply of industrial and commercial packaging products. The Company specializes in BOPP bags, BOPP printing rolls, BOPP lamination rolls, PP woven bags and PP woven lamination rolls, serving customers across industries such as food processing, fertilizers, chemicals, cement and seeds. The Company operates an integrated manufacturing facility in Rajkot, Gujarat, with capabilities including extrusion, coating and lamination, rotogravure printing, stitching and finishing.

It is engaged in the manufacturing of low-voltage wires and cables rated up to 1.1 kV and markets its products under the brand name “JOHNSON CABLES”, catering to power infrastructure, renewable energy, railways and industrial applications.The Company’s product portfolio includes control cables, power cables, industrial single-core and multicore cables, house and building wires, welding cables, solar/photovoltaic cables and submersible flat cables. Its products are designed for applications across power transmission and distribution, renewable energy integration, industrial operations and allied sectors. The Company holds ISO and BIS certifications to support product quality and compliance with applicable standards.

ipos.about: Incorporated in September 2022, Maxwell Engineering Solutions Limited is a precision engineering company engaged in the manufacturing, trading and servicing of critical components for underwater pelletizing systems. The Company manufactures a range of components for underwater pelletizing systems, including pelletizing die plates, pelletizing blades and knives, blade holders, cutter hubs, tapped driving bushes and other spare parts. Its products cater to polymer compounding, masterbatches, engineering plastics, cable compounds, specialty polymers and plastics recycling industries. The Company also undertakes customised manufacturing based on customer specifications and offers white-label manufacturing, enabling customers to market products under their own brands. Its business operates through three segments: manufacturing, services and trading.
